repo.description:
## Impact

A Resource Locator parameter stores a URL that its dropdown offers as an external link, and that URL was opened without checking its scheme. A workflow author could set it to a script URL, so arbitrary JavaScript ran in the editor origin when another user opened the node's dropdown and clicked the external-link icon. The value is persisted in the workflow and served back to anyone who opens, imports or is shared it.

## Patches

The issue has been fixed in n8n versions 1.123.80, 2.39.6, and 2.40.1. Users should upgrade to one of these versions or later to remediate the vulnerability.

## Workarounds

If upgrading is not immediately possible, administrators should consider the following temporary mitigations:
- Restrict n8n instance access to fully trusted users only.
- Audit shared and imported workflows for Resource Locator parameters containing unexpected URL values and remove any that are not recognized.

These workarounds do not fully remediate the risk and should only be used as short-term mitigation measures.
repo.summary: Stored DOM XSS via Resource Locator Dropdown Link Handling
